    We originally designed ScooterAI with two evaluation rounds. On paper, it made sense. In practice, candidates told us something else — by not completing it. Nothing was broken. The process was simply asking for more than it needed. So we reduced it to one round. That forced us to be ruthless about signal. Building early has taught me one thing: It doesn’t matter how good your process is until it hits the sweet spot between rigor and reality.

    We’re Hiring Full Stack Developer Interns!

    At ScooterAI, we are revolutionizing sales hiring by combining artificial intelligence and behavioral science to create a smarter, fairer, and faster way for companies to find top sales talent. Our platform replaces traditional resumes and interviews with advanced assessments, voice validations, and insightful video analytics, helping businesses hire the right people confidently while giving candidates a fair shot to showcase their true skills.

    We’re now building the next generation of AI tools and automation, and we need passionate Full Stack Developer Interns to join our early-stage team and shape the future of AI-enhanced hiring.

    What you’ll do:
    1.Build REST APIs with FastAPI (Python) 🐍
    2.Create clean, beautiful UIs with React / Next.js + Tailwind CSS 🎨
    3.Plug into cloud platforms like Azure / Firebase / AWS ☁️
    4.Collaborate with our team on real AI automation and voice projects 💬
    5.Write code that’s not just functional — but scalable, elegant & future-ready ⚡

    You’re a great fit if you:
    1.Speak Python and JavaScript/TypeScript fluently
    2.Know your way around FastAPI, React, or Next.js
    3.Understand REST, auth flows, and databases
    4.Get excited about AI/ML, automation, voice tech, or Video Analytics

    Duration: 3 months (unpaid evaluation phase)

    Outcome: Internship certificate + potential full-time role based on performance

    If you’re a builder, dreamer, and doer who loves experimenting with AI, we’d love to meet you. Let’s create something awesome together.

    You finally land that big interview—your dream company, your dream role.
    The recruiter smiles. “Tell me about yourself.”
    Your heart pounds. Your voice cracks.

    Then come the technical questions.
    You’ve prepared for months. But in the moment? Your mind goes blank.
    The interviewer nods. “We’ll get back to you.”
    Crickets. Silence. Your inbox stays empty.
    No response. No feedback. No idea what went wrong.
    🎯 Sounds familiar? You’re not alone.
    I’ve been there.
    There was a time when I had no idea where to start in IT.
    Backend? Frontend? AI? Cloud? Which one was right for me?
    ❓ What should I study?
    ❓ How long will it take?
    ❓ How do I even prepare for MNCs vs. startups?
    I jumped between free resources, random tutorials, and endless YouTube videos—
    trying to figure it all out. Alone.
    And only after getting my first job did I realize how much time I had wasted.

    That’s why we are building     https://learn.imaigen.ai/

    ✅ Get clarity on IT career paths—no more confusion.
    ✅ Train for interviews with AI—before facing real recruiters.
    ✅ Fix your resume before it lands in the rejection pile.
    ✅ Get AI Powered hyper-personalized feedback on your progress—so you know exactly what to improve.
    ✅ Fail, learn, and improve—without risking real opportunities.

        From Vision to Reality.

        The Journey Behind Our New AI-Powered Student Platform! 🎓

        A few months ago, our team at         IMAIGEN AI set out on a mission—to bridge the gap between students and their dream careers. We saw a challenge that many students face: cracking interviews, tracking progress, and understanding where to improve. The journey wasn’t just about building another platform—it was about creating something meaningful, something that truly makes an impact.

        💡 How It All Started...

        We spent countless hours talking to students, mentors, and recruiters, understanding what really matters in the placement journey. Some needed structured feedback, some lacked confidence, and many wished they had a way to measure their progress. That’s where AI came in—not just as a tool, but as a guide, a mentor that learns and grows with you.

        👨‍💻 The Team That Made It Possible
        This wasn’t just my vision—it was a collective effort. Our engineers worked relentlessly, perfecting algorithms that could analyze student performance. Our AI experts crafted models that could provide real-time insights. Our designers ensured the platform felt intuitive and engaging. Every late-night brainstorming session, every obstacle we overcame—it all led to this moment.

        🔥 What We’ve Built
        Today, we’re thrilled to introduce a game-changer for students:
        ✅ AI-driven assessments that helps to identify strengths & weaknesses
        ✅ Transforming Performance with Personalized Dashboards
        ✅ Ace Interviews with real time insights
        ✅ Personalized Roadmaps based on Career specific Goals
        ✅ Master Communication with AI Voice Bot
        ✅ Dominate Interviews with AI-Powered Mock Interview
        ✅ Maximize Growth with AI-Driven Recommendations

        🎯 What’s Next? We Need YOU!
        Before we roll this out to thousands of students, we want your feedback. This is YOUR platform—built for students, powered by AI, shaped by real experiences. We’re opening up access to early users who want to test, explore, and help us make it even better.

        💬 Drop a comment or DM me if you want early access. Let’s shape the future of student placements together!

        Registrations Open!!

        Click here to join waitlist : https://lnkd.in/dsxEtSGy
